stem: Which of the following best defines agenesis?

options.text: Abnormal arrangement of cells within tissues
Excessive cellular proliferation within an organ
Absolute failure of an organ or anatomical structure to form
Failure of cells to proliferate after an initial rudimentary form has developed
Incomplete development of an organ with reduced size

explanation: Agenesis means absolute failure of an organ or anatomical structure to form, so the structure is completely absent from the start of development.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because abnormal arrangement of cells within tissues describes dysplasia, not agenesis.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because excessive cellular proliferation within an organ describes hyperplasia, not agenesis.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because agenesis is the absolute failure of an organ or anatomical structure to form.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because failure of cells to proliferate after an initial rudimentary form has developed is more consistent with aplasia.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because incomplete development of an organ with reduced size describes hypoplasia, not agenesis.

source.hint: This term refers to the most extreme form of failure in organ development.
